body.claim: In 1980, hard drives that could store more than a gigabyte already existed. IBM's 3380 held 2.52 GB.
body.why: IBM introduced the 3380 on 11 June 1980. NEC's N7755, also from 1980, held 1.27 GB. Both were early drives in the gigabyte era.
